prompts.prompt: Create a premium realistic fantasy game environment background, landscape panoramic 16:9 or wider composition. Dragon Grove Chapter II: canyon flight above an ancient woodland valley. NO dragon, NO characters, NO text, NO interface, NO icons, NO geometric props. Cinematic photorealistic game concept art with believable natural detail: soaring sandstone and weathered granite cliffs to left and right, a sinuous river far below, dense varied emerald forest, distant blue mountains, shafts of late-afternoon gold light, soft layered mist for depth. View is from the air looking forward through a broad open valley, horizontal horizon around the upper third, clear open air in the central 60 percent where a 3D dragon and small flying objects will be composited. Closest rock/foliage edges give strong foreground parallax cues without obstructing central flight lane. Rich organic surfaces, believable scale, crisp but atmospheric, restrained colour grading, majestic adventurous mood, visually coherent with a realistic green woodland dragon. All parts painted through to the edges, seamless landscape composition. Not low poly, not cartoon, not a diagram, no checkerboard.

Create a premium photorealistic fantasy game background landscape, panoramic 16:9 composition for Dragon Grove Chapter II forest sanctuary. NO dragon, NO characters, NO text, NO interface. View forward into a grand ancient temperate woodland with huge organically twisted moss-covered tree trunks along both edges, a broad clear central clearing and a shallow ribbon of clear spring water, ferns and hanging vines framing a golden sunlit corridor, layered forest in the distance, a few luminous seedpods nestled naturally in the distant foliage, subtle drifting pollen. The central 60 percent is open enough for a 3D dragon and animated small objects to be composited. Natural detailed bark, foliage and rocks, cinematic dappled sunlight from upper left, rich restrained forest green and warm amber, believable organic surfaces, soft atmospheric depth but crisp foreground, majestic welcoming mood. Realistic high quality game concept art that matches a detailed green textured European dragon. Entire landscape painted to edges. Not low poly, not cartoon, no geometric props, no checkerboard.

Create a premium photorealistic fantasy game environment background, panoramic landscape 16:9 for Dragon Grove Chapter II storm-coast flight. NO dragon, NO characters, NO text, NO interface. A dramatic rugged sea coast seen from the air looking forward through a broad flight corridor: tall organically weathered basalt and limestone cliffs along the sides, wild emerald grass at rocky edges, enormous rolling dark teal ocean below, islands in the middle distance, distant mountains, cloud layers sweeping across a moody blue-grey sky. A warm break in the clouds illuminates the open central valley of air and reflects gold on waves; a subtle distant lightning fork at the far right. Keep the central 60 percent free of obstructing foreground forms for a flying 3D dragon and moving natural targets. Detailed believable sea spray, rock textures and clouds, cinematic lighting, atmospheric depth, restrained teal/steel with soft amber accents. Majestic adventurous, suitable for a child's fantasy dragon adventure, ominous but not frightening. Not cartoon, not low-poly, no geometric props, no checkerboard. Entire composition painted to edges.

Create a production game sprite atlas on a TRUE transparent background with six isolated realistic fantasy natural objects, arranged precisely in a 3-column by 2-row grid. Landscape overall aspect ratio 3:2, intended1536 by1024, six equal square cells. No visible grid, no text, no labels, no UI, no floor plane, no checkerboard. Each object centered within its own square cell and fully contained with at least10 percent transparent padding on all sides; no parts/glow cross into adjacent cells. Cinematic photorealistic fantasy-game style, highly detailed natural organic textures, consistent soft warm light upper left. ROW1 LEFT: a single rugged rounded grey mossy boulder with cracks and small tufts of moss. ROW1 CENTRE: a compact tangled mass of curling thorny bramble roots, twisted brown woody vines and a few dark green leaves. ROW1 RIGHT: a small golden woodland bird with outspread feathered wings, complete bird visible in dynamic flying pose, friendly lifelike anatomy. ROW2 LEFT: an organic luminous golden-green seedpod formed of layered curled leaves, small warm magical light inside, subtle tightly contained glow. ROW2 CENTRE: a softly swirling dark violet smoky wisp with a brighter purple core, irregular organic smoke tendrils fully within cell, gentle fantasy obstacle, not a face or monster. ROW2 RIGHT: a natural round woven woodland bird nest with a few soft feathers, viewed three-quarter from above, complete nest fully visible. Keep clear silhouette, no oversized cast shadows, no geometric symbols. These assets will be cropped by exact grid cell coordinates and composited into a realistic dragon flying game.
